constraints: no NTCP2 cryptography or handshake state mutation
exactly one outbound dial per invocation when in dial mode
bounded monotonic timeout per phase (default 15 s, max 600)
no retries, no sleeps-as-state-readiness, no DNS, no public network egress
no streaming destination, no tunnel pool, no client destination
no SAM, no I2CP, no floodfill integration
disposable data directory is mode 0700 and never inherited
nonzero exit code on every rejected or blocked outcome
real embedded Router is constructed exactly once
real Router.shutdown() is invoked through the embedded lifecycle
DeliveryStatus is the only I2NP message type emitted by the data-phase path
exactly one synthesized DeliveryStatus is dispatched per dial invocation
verification_required: correct RouterInfo validation against the local router identity
exact peer RouterInfo validation (signature, network ID, hash, address)
wired RouterContext dummy NetDB lookup returns the imported peer
successful embedded router lifecycle (start, listener, shutdown)
exact DeliveryStatus message ID correlation on send and receive
no listener port, lock file, or writable state survives outside owned roots
structured event emission matches the Plan 062 reference-event v1 schema
no SAM, no HTTP, no floodfill topology, no support router
